Subject: Post-call recap + proposed demo windows and procurement checklist

Hi Alex —

Great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing slips: 

- Goal: Technical demo focused on inference throughput + deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Stakeholders we should have: your Platform lead (for VPC/SSO), Security reviewer, and Procurement/Legal for buying path.

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Tue 6/22 10:00–11:00
- Wed 6/23 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Thu 6/24 14:00–15:00

Can you confirm which one works and who from your side will be joining? I attached a short procurement checklist and a mutual action plan to speed approvals. If you want, we can split the session: 30 min platform/deployment + 30 min security deep-dive.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, procurement-checklist.pdf

Thanks — looping in Marissa (solutions) and Monica (security engagement) so we can coordinate pre-reads and the demo agenda.

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Perfect — appreciate the quick reply.

Marissa/Monica: can you confirm Redwood availability for Wed 6/23 10:00 PT? If that works we'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Priya / procurement: in advance of the call, two quick asks so we come prepared:
- Security: can you share the top-3 compliance priorities (e.g., audit logs, data segregation, KMS integration)? We also have a one-page SSO & network checklist attached (redwood-sso-questionnaire.docx).
- Procurement: any PO/contract templates or redline process notes we should be aware of? We can run a quick procurement sync after the demo if that helps.

Alternate slots if Wed becomes constrained: Tue 6/22 10am or Thu 6/24 2pm (PT). Also here is a quick Doodle if you prefer to vote on times: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123
